event.name: Idaho Falls YMCA Fall Family Festival

profile.description: 2026 post-Labor-Day prospect. Fall Family Festival is Saturday Sept. 12, 2026, 9 AM-2 PM at Broadway Plaza on Memorial Drive alongside the Idaho Falls Farmers Market. Audience fit is excellent for Adventure Zone, but physical/operating fit is uncertain because it is a five-hour downtown plaza event; verify available footprint before offering a full package. No current inflatable provider is advertised on the official event page.

notes.body: Desiree sent personalized outreach to Donovan Stokes at dstokes@idahofallsymca.org on Aug. 27, 2026. Current official YMCA leadership information verifies Donovan as Program & Fundraising Director. Official event details confirm Sept. 12, 9 AM-2 PM at Broadway Plaza with family activities and community vendors. This is a strong audience fit but a questionable full-carnival footprint because the event is downtown and only five hours; if Donovan is interested, first verify available square footage, setup access and operating expectations before promising a package.
